resolved_or_improved.evidence: Outcome Closure now requires a receipt resolved against exactly one pinned AcceptanceRegistrySnapshot record plus TrustedAcceptanceContext. It verifies registry snapshot hash, installation/workspace identity, verifier/policy/anchor allowlists, record hash, revocation/trust eligibility, enumerated acceptance route and exact field equality. Missing registry/context or forged/unregistered receipt remains MODEL_LEARNED_SLOW_PLANNING.

OWNER_SEEDED/GOVERNANCE_DERIVED require authority scope/evidence binding; EXPERIENCE_CANDIDATE must remain shadow and cannot carry executable scope. authority_from_drive remains 0 and generalized self-preservation authority remains 0.

Kernel-owned semantic dedupe, finite attention budget, opportunity-cost allocation, diversity reserve, satiation, fixation penalty and cooldown remain present. Goal surfacing requires admitted canonical goal plus appraisal evidence, contradiction-clear state, benefit/cost/risk/protected-impact/why-now/uncertainty/ecology bindings, and remains proposal-only with authority_from_drive=0, external_action_allowed=false and canonical_personality_write=false.

LIVE_SHADOW_ADOPTABLE now fail-closes without external trusted_anchor_root and bound workspace identity; RESEARCH_ONLY is explicitly promotion-ineligible. Ledger verifies hash chain, dedupe, accepted head, external monotonic anchor, workspace binding and single-writer behavior. Trusted provider/install authority semantics remain external and TEST_REQUIRED.

high_bounded_vetoes.finding: SelfOriginEvidenceChain still consumes ExperienceEvidence.trust and anchor_alignment directly. appraisal_binding_hash is only checked for non-empty presence; it is not resolved to or recomputed from canonical DerivedAppraisal bytes/reference. Eligibility and self_origin_score therefore still depend on producer-carried appraisal values.
high_bounded_vetoes.required_change: Self-Origin evaluation must consume a verified canonical DerivedAppraisal envelope/reference (or trusted acceptance registry record) and derive trust/alignment/cross-context eligibility from that pinned evidence, never from free ExperienceEvidence fields. Historical origin remains immutable; derived SELF_ANCHOR candidate must be a new node with lineage.
acceptance_tests: non-empty arbitrary appraisal_binding_hash plus forged high trust/alignment is rejected
post-appraisal mutation of trust/alignment is rejected
same lineage with many distinct event ids cannot satisfy cross-context/lineage promotion
canonical appraisal policy/anchor registry mismatch rejects promotion

high_bounded_vetoes.finding: ValueDesireKernel.update() still calls _apply_time_decay(state) before checking RUNTIME_ONLY_DOMAINS. Runtime pulse count therefore changes nonzero fast/slow drive state even though pulses add no Experience evidence. Pulse frequency can alter later Desire/Goal/personality-candidate outputs.
high_bounded_vetoes.required_change: Cognitive decay must be driven only by trusted elapsed cognitive time or an explicit bounded reconciliation clock, never by number of runtime pulses. Runtime-only events may update diagnostics but must leave cognitive state fingerprints invariant for equal trusted elapsed time.
acceptance_tests: seed nonzero fast/slow drive; 1 pulse vs 10000 mixed runtime pulses at identical trusted elapsed time yields identical cognitive fingerprint
Experience count, verified count, seen source-event evidence, Self-Origin eligibility and base Personality/Identity/Governance fingerprints remain unchanged
only explicitly allowed TTL/decay driven by trusted elapsed time may change

partial_gaps.finding: LiveShadowAppraisalChokePoint exists and rejects legacy dict/tampered DerivedAppraisal envelopes, but legacy ValueDesireKernel.ExperienceInput still publicly accepts trust, independently_verified, anchor_alignment, cross_context_count, satiation and repeated_goal_count. No fresh integration evidence proves every Small-Nest live ingestion path must pass the canonical choke point before kernel use.

Outcome Closure registry/context logic is substantially repaired, but the trusted registry snapshot, revocation freshness, installation/workspace identity and verifier/policy/anchor allowlists are modeled host inputs. Non-forgeable provider rooting, rotation and rollback protection remain unproven.

threshold_policy: All numeric thresholds, coefficients, decay constants, budgets, cadence values and promotion cutoffs remain TEST_REQUIRED until empirically calibrated and independently verified.

Repair runtime decay to trusted elapsed cognitive time and execute nonzero-state 10000-pulse invariance suite
Make live Appraisal-to-Kernel choke point mandatory for all Small-Nest ingestion
Independently verify acceptance-registry and ledger external provider rooting, installation identity, revocation and rollback semantics
